title: 劍雨落入耕田
camera: cinematic diagonal 16:9 wide shot from falling sword rain to irrigation furrows
action_description: Lu Qinghe, Qin Wulou, farmers and outer disciples redirect lethal silver sword rain through wooden sluices and irrigation channels as the first hazardous sword-grain bends with the water
mood: perilous improvisation and communal labor without effortless victory
